JAINA_POWER_MINION_SQUAD_POWER.title: Minion Squad
JAINA_POWER_MINION_SQUAD_POWER.descripti: When Jaina's Block cannot absorb damage, minions take damage in summon order.

JAINA_POWER_FREEZE_POWER.title: Freeze
JAINA_POWER_FREEZE_POWER.description: Frozen characters deal 25% less damage with attacks. Stacks up to 4 times. All stacks are removed at end of turn.
JAINA_POWER_FREEZE_POWER.smartDescriptio: Deals 25% less damage with attacks. Stacks up to 4 times.
JAINA_POWER_JAINA_ATTACK_ACTION.title: Attack

JAINA_POWER_PEAK_INFINITY_POWER.descript: At the start of your next turn, return Peak Infinity to your hand.
JAINA_POWER_PEAK_INFINITY_POWER.smartDes: At the start of your next turn, return Peak Infinity to your hand.
JAINA_POWER_OBJECTION_POWER.title: Objection

JAINA_POWER_OBJECTION_POWER.smartDescrip: The enemy's next Attack intent deals no damage.
JAINA_POWER_COUNTERSPELL_POWER.title: Counterspell

JAINA_POWER_EMPOWER_POWER.title: Empower

JAINA_POWER_EMPOWER_POWER.smartDescripti: Each stack: Hero Power damage +1 and summon an extra 1/1 Imp.
JAINA_POWER_UNFAIR_GAME_POWER.title: Unfair Game
JAINA_POWER_UNFAIR_GAME_POWER.descriptio: If you take no damage while this is active, draw 3 cards at the start of your next turn, then remove this.
JAINA_POWER_UNFAIR_GAME_POWER.smartDescr: If you take no damage this turn, draw 3 cards at the start of your next turn.
JAINA_POWER_OPEN_TIME_GATE_POWER.title: Open the Time Gate (Quest)
JAINA_POWER_OPEN_TIME_GATE_POWER.descrip: After you cast 8 Spell cards from outside your deck, gain a reward: Time Warp. Only manually played spells count; auto-played ones do not.
JAINA_POWER_OPEN_TIME_GATE_POWER.smartDe: Quest in progress: cast Spells from outside your deck (played by hand) to gain a reward.
JAINA_POWER_FORBIDDEN_SEQUENCE_POWER.des: Each time you Discover a card, count it. After Discovering 8 cards (7 when upgraded), gain a reward: Forbidden Stone.
JAINA_POWER_FORBIDDEN_SEQUENCE_POWER.sma: Quest in progress: Discover cards to gain a reward.
JAINA_POWER_FORBIDDEN_STONE_POWER.title: Forbidden Stone
JAINA_POWER_FORBIDDEN_STONE_POWER.descri: After you Discover a card, automatically play the other options and lose 1 Durability. Durability 8; when it reaches 0, this ability is lost.
JAINA_POWER_FORBIDDEN_STONE_POWER.smartD: After Discovering, auto-play the other options; Durability decreases.
